# TimGM6mb — General MIDI SoundFont

**Author:** Tim Brechbill
**License:** GPL-2.0 (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)) — the same text ManagedDoom ships as
`licenses/LICENSE_TimGM6mb.txt`.
**Snapshot:** 2026-11-04, `TimGM6mb.sf2` (5969788 bytes, sha256
`c5378b62028c920cb11e4803327983fee2f2cdff5dc89c708e39da417e51c854`), taken out of
ManagedDoom's release archive `managed-doom-v2.1a-win-x64.zip`
(https://github.com/sinshu/managed-doom/releases/tag/v2.1a) — the SoundFont
ManagedDoom's configuration names by default (`audio_soundfont`). Only this file
was extracted; nothing else from the archive.
**Also distributed by:** MuseScore (GM SoundFonts,
https://musescore.org/en/handbook/soundfonts-and-sfz-files#gm_soundfonts).

Staged as `\games\TimGM6mb.sf2` beside DOOM.EXE; DOOM's music (`SharpMusic`,
step250) synthesises with it. GPL-2.0 as DOOM itself is: it travels with the
GPL application, not with the kernel.
